messages:
claire (Docs): Opened PR to add a short GDPR/DSR section on audit-logs plus Kotlin & Swift SDK examples and a short localization note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5421
ivan (Security): Thanks. Two asks: 1) public text must say deletions/purges may be delayed due to lawful holds and backup cycles; 2) for EU customers explicitly mention data subject request (DSR) handling and that export/purge timelines follow applicable law.
greta (Legal): Draft legal-friendly sentence: "Redwood retains audit logs in accordance with the customer's retention policy. Export and deletion requests are fulfilled subject to lawful holds, contractual obligations, and applicable data protection laws (e.g., GDPR)." Also recommend a brief line about DSARs: requests handled per legal timelines.
claire (Docs): Great, I'll add that wording verbatim to the public doc. I'll also add an internal note about escalation path for emergency purges.
hugo (DevEx): I'll add Kotlin & Swift code snippets for export + a short DSAR checklist. Do we want to show a purge call example? We have `audit.purge` in v0.9 SDKs.
sam (Intl): One localization ask: translate the short legal sentence in our supported languages and mark it as "non-normative" in translations to avoid legal drift. Also use "customer" not "tenant" everywhere.\l
claire (Docs): Will replace tenant->customer and add localization flag. Adding ISO-8601 TTL examples (P30D, P90D) too.
hugo (DevEx): Kotlin example (compact):
```kotlin
val client = RedwoodClient("$TOKEN")
client.audit.export(mapOf("since" to "2027-01-01", "format" to "jsonl", "page_size" to "200")) { chunk -> println(chunk) }
```
Swift example (compact):
```swift
let client = RedwoodClient(apiKey: TOKEN)
client.audit.export(params: ["since":"2027-01-01","format":"jsonl"]) { page in
  print(page)
}
```
ivan (Security): Add a one-line caveat under snippets: "Purge/deletion requests may not immediately remove data from backups or archives; contact support for special retention/purge arrangements." Also call out that exported redacted records are irreversible.
greta (Legal): Approved the public wording and translation approach. One tiny nit: use "retention policy" (singular) when referring to customer settings.
claire (Docs): Updated accordingly and pushed a small migration note for SDK method renames (old -> new). Adding Greta & Ivan as reviewers and will merge once CI passes. Thanks all :sparkles:
